core_loop: RanchGameView implements touch drag recipe cards to animal pens
Animals use production timers, ready states, mood, product quality, and collection
Order cards consume collected inventory and award coins plus reputation
Day timer and reputation target drive clear or failure outcomes
content_budget: Six normal animals are present: cow, hen, sheep, goat, piglet, rabbit
Five feed recipe cards are implemented with recipe stock and animal favorites
Six product families are represented through animal products and order generation
Quality tiers are implemented as standard, fresh, premium, and perfect
screen_and_controls: Game states include MENU, PLAYING, PAUSED, and GAME_OVER
MainActivity provides start, pause, resume, restart, help, and sound controls
Gameplay view includes cookbook rail, delivery clipboard, HUD badges, cooler dock, and result dialog
visual_and_audio: Runtime animal drawing uses recognizable silhouettes for cow, hen, sheep, goat, piglet, and rabbit
Runtime art map is integrated with anchors, hitboxes, z-order, states, and animation rules
UI assignment and UI brief track the cookbook, clipboard, HUD, safe area, and asset strategy
Audio assignment covers menu, play, win, fail BGM plus required ranch SFX
Icon workflow generated project icons and upload exports with high-trust metadata

non_blocking_notes: Persistent progression is represented by day advancement, increasing reputation targets, coin rewards, recipe restock, and stronger order generation in this build.
The current APK package scope is suitable for repository delivery even though future expansion could add a dedicated upgrade sheet.
